# HexPiece 2.9.8

Your note on 2.9.7: the light sword (Ama no Murakumo) was held wrong and looked bad. Redone after your own reference frame of Kizaru at
Egghead (the sword hanging from his hand, the ring and cross at his fist). Not tested in game yet; the build and tests pass, and I
rendered and checked it in third and first person.

- **Held right:** your hand now closes on a short grip with the ring and cross right at the fist. Before, the ring sat two thirds of a
  block out along the blade and the hand held a bare rod behind it.
- **At rest it hangs like in your reference:** the arm easy at your side, the blade pointing down and ahead past your legs (before, it
  was held straight out in front).
- **Looks like a sword of light now:** a proper glowing blade (white-hot core, gold sheath, soft glow) instead of a hair-thin line,
  1.9 blocks long instead of 2.6 (it was taller than you), a glint at the point, and the ring and cross doubled up so the crosshair
  shows from every side, with the burst of light at the hand.
- Same sword in your hand in first person, in the C lunge, and in the clones' hands.
